Input Tax Credit = tumhara paisa. Lekin tabhi milega agar:

✅ Supplier ne GSTR-1 file kiya ho (2B mein dikhe)
✅ Sahi GSTIN ke saath tax invoice ho
✅ Supplier ko payment 180 din mein kiya ho

Sabse bada loss: supplier ne return file nahi kiya, tumhara ITC atka. Har month GSTR-2B se milao!
